A priest/attendant is directly ahead, within arm’s reach. He begins facing the altar, then turns toward the camera wearer and gestures near the banana. The decorated altar is just beyond him, also within close reach, with other ritual items and offerings already placed there. He partially occupies the direct path to the altar, suggesting the wearer should approach respectfully and follow his guidance. In this setting, the banana is most appropriately placed on the altar as an offering.
